gaps: All photographs null pending licensed Commons visual review.
Modern families require actual generation splitting and factory production intervals; EPA model years are never used as factory dates.
Early range missing U/30-U/PA/PB/PC/PD/PE/PF/PG/PJ/P1–P15, Roadking/Deluxe/Special Deluxe.
Postwar missing Cambridge, Cranbrook, Concord, Plaza, Savoy, Suburban, Volare, Cricket, Arrow, Sapporo, Duster/Scamp history and Canadian/Australian market differences.
1970 historic snapshots do not establish complete Fury/Belvedere/Satellite/GTX/Road Runner/Valiant/Duster production histories.
Sundance Convertible EPA 1989 label excluded as suspicious; no convertible identity inferred. Sundance/Duster remains distinct from historic Duster.
Nominal litres and historic cubic-inch labels are not converted into exact displacementCc. EPA lacks power; historic HP not converted. Mass, dimensions and acceleration remain unverified.

EPA record selection samples first/middle/last years and first three configurations, not all motors or AWD combinations. Prowler EPA presence begins 1999 although OEM press release establishes 1997 start; historical identity still needs patch.
excluded: Pickups, vans and military vehicles. Passenger Voyager/Grand Voyager MPV family retained; no commercial van line added.
PT Cruiser excluded: Chrysler production identity, not Plymouth.
sourceNotes: US DOE/EPA JSON responses preserved under night-plymouth-epa-evidence.json. No customer data.
EPA zero/sentinel values are never used as literal range, power or cargo measurements.
Original OEM brochures used via preservation archives; no commercial stock images copied.
Museum Barracuda restomod power/transmission expressly excluded.
